digest.component_or_area: adapters/jira/ and new adapters/jira_family/ shared layer
propositions: Extract Jira-family-general symbols (identity convention, probe classifier, field sanitizers, link vocabulary, value maps) from adapters/jira/ into a new shared adapters/jira_family/ package to eliminate unsanctioned cross-adapter imports and establish a clean architectural seam.

Move identity.py wholly; move classify_probe_response to jira_family as a parameterized classifier taking resolved-status set as required keyword-only argument, leaving RESOLVED_STATUS_NAMES and probe() in adapters/jira/.

Split jira_fields.py by symbol: move pure sanitizers and maps outright; move _sanitize_description and _sanitize_comment as contract-parameterized functions receiving injected RichTextCodec and comment-limit dependencies.
Deduplicate the drifted local-to-Jira status and priority maps into a single definition in jira_family/, adopting the outbound_fields.py value for deleted status (Done instead of invalid Deleted).

Keep adapters/jira/adf.py, comment_limits.py, and outbound_fields.py at their pinned paths via dependency inversion; re-point their imports to jira_family/ symbols and use absolute imports only to survive spec_from_file_location synthetic-name loading.

Update all internal importers and mock.patch strings; re-point test_config.py's by-path parity test to load the status map from its new jira_family/ location; enforce the import contract with an AST-walking test asserting acyclic dependencies between adapter packages.
